theme: envy: others started first while you waited
experiment: After the 2026-11-24 flop (reach 1, 0 engagement; six carousels all at reach 1): new hook type (comparison, others moved first, instead of contrast), new theme, CTA changed to send-to-one-friend-and-start-together, hashtag mix rotated. Photo style, 7 slides and ~22:00 IST unchanged.

slides.text: Everyone you envy started while you [[waited]].
They were never more ready. They were just [[earlier]].
Every day you compare is a day you did not [[build]].
Momentum is not found. It is [[earned]].
A year from now you will have [[proof]] or excuses.
Decide now. [[Send]] this to one friend and start together.
